当你的应用需要对敏感数据进行加密存储或传输时使用加解密能力
典型场景包括用户密码加密存储、通信数据加密传输、文件加密保护等
根据数据量大小选择单次加解密或分段加解密，根据安全需求选择对称加解密（高效，适合大量数据）或非对称加解密（安全性高，适合密钥交换）
当你的应用需要验证数据完整性或进行身份认证时使用签名验签和消息摘要能力
典型场景包括数字签名验证、数据防篡改检测、消息完整性校验等
当你的应用需要在通信双方之间安全地协商共享密钥时使用密钥协商能力，当需要从密码或共享秘密中派生出加密密钥时使用密钥派生能力
给本地保存的敏感配置做加密保护 / Encrypt sensitive local configuration before storing it
实现文件内容加密后再写入沙箱 / Encrypt file contents before writing them to app storage
对接口请求做数字签名并在服务端验签 / Sign API requests and verify signatures on the server
生成安全随机密钥和初始化向量IV / Generate cryptographically secure keys and IVs
用 PBKDF2 从用户密码派生出加密密钥 / Derive an encryption key from a user password with PBKDF2
计算下载文件的摘要用于完整性校验 / Compute a digest for downloaded files to verify integrity
给消息摘要加 HMAC 防止请求被篡改 / Protect message digests with HMAC to prevent tampering
导入导出 RSA 或 ECC 密钥对并安全管理 / Import, export, and manage RSA or ECC key pairs securely
对传输中的业务数据做端到端加密 / Apply end-to-end encryption to business data in transit
使用 AES-GCM 对字符串或二进制数据进行加密 / Encrypt strings or binary data with AES-GCM
实现国密 SM2 SM3 SM4 的加密签名与摘要 / Implement encryption, signing, and hashing with SM2 SM3 SM4
校验签名证明确认数据来源未被伪造 / Verify signatures to confirm data origin and authenticity
preconditions: 工程已集成可用的 Crypto Architecture Kit 接口并与当前 API 版本兼容 / The project has integrated available Crypto Architecture Kit APIs and they are compatible with the current API version
调用方已准备好所选算法要求的合法参数，例如密钥长度、IV、AAD、填充模式或曲线参数 / The caller has prepared valid parameters required by the chosen algorithm, such as key length, IV, AAD, padding mode, or curve parameters
输入密钥材料、PEM 字符串或二进制数据格式与目标算法规格一致 / Input key material, PEM strings, or binary data formats conform to the target algorithm specification
相关密码学操作未被设计为同一对象上的多线程并发调用 / The cryptographic operation is not designed as multithreaded concurrent use on the same object
inputs: 待加解密、签名、验签或摘要计算的数据 / Data to encrypt, decrypt, sign, verify, or digest
算法名称与模式参数 / Algorithm name and mode parameters
密钥、密钥对、PEM 字符串或原始密钥字节 / Key, key pair, PEM string, or raw key bytes
初始化向量、随机数种子、AAD、盐值或派生参数 / IV, random seed input, AAD, salt, or derivation parameters

postconditions.statement: 代码显式调用了 Crypto Architecture Kit 的密码学 API，而不是仅停留在伪代码或注释层面 / The code explicitly invokes Crypto Architecture Kit cryptographic APIs rather than staying at pseudocode or comment level
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set add or modify concrete ArkTS or C/C++ code that calls Crypto Architecture Kit APIs for cryptographic work, instead of only adding comments, placeholders, or unrelated logic?

postconditions.statement: 所实现的操作与请求目标一致，并包含对应的算法/模式配置 / The implemented operation matches the requested goal and includes the corresponding algorithm/mode configuration
postconditions.judge_prompt: By inspecting the edits, is the requested cryptographic task actually implemented (such as encrypt/decrypt, sign/verify, digest, MAC, key agreement, derivation, or random generation) with a specified algorithm or mode?

postconditions.statement: 新增实现消费了必要输入并产生了可继续使用的结果对象或输出数据 / The added implementation consumes the necessary inputs and produces a reusable result object or output data
postconditions.judge_prompt: Do the edits show the cryptographic call wiring required inputs (data, key material, and parameters where applicable) and storing, returning, or forwarding the resulting ciphertext, plaintext, signature, digest, derived key, or random bytes?
